title: Phase setup
description: Setup values collected by the phase-start skill (Telegram 'start <phase>'). Stored by the start_phase tool, which returns a week-1 preview computed by code. The phase starts only after the user taps confirm. Values that already exist from an earlier phase are reused unless the user changes them.

maintenance_estimate_kcal.description: From the last diet weeks; code converts it to base maintenance by subtracting average counted activity.

training_plan_source.description: The training plan saved in the coach (seeded once from the CSV, changed in chat).

lifting_kcal_per_session.description: kcal counted per lifting session that shows up in Hevy.

cut_level.description: cut only: the deficit level (phase-cut params cut.levels_kcal). With a goal too, the level decides the deficit and the goal is shown against it.

goal.description: cut only: a goal weight, or a goal body fat with the current body fat (the user's estimate; left out, code takes the latest body-fat estimate, the user's or from photos), and the date to reach it by. Code derives the rate and deficit it needs.

end_date.description: cut only, optional: the last day of a mini-cut. From the day after, the coach asks to end the phase.

deficit_kcal.description: cut only: computed by code at the preview from cut_level or goal (never recorded by the model).

step_goal.description: Steps where step kcal are 0 (default steps.step_goal). Changeable during a phase; it moves only where 0 is shown, not the energy.

block_weeks.description: Optional: weeks per training block (default reviews.block_weeks). Changeable during a phase, from the day it is set; a block review follows each block.
